_meta.method: Manufacturer data: Aconity3D datasheets (2018 MIDI flyer, 2019 MIDI+ flyer, 2022 MIDI/MIDI+ datasheets, Jan-2026 booklet pages) and the live Aconity3D configurator API that feeds the aconity3d.com product pages (fetched 2026-09-26). Layout sub-dimensions are NOT published; they were scaled from near-orthographic front photos: MIDI from the CMU photo (filter unit + machine + control cabinet = 607 px wide set equal to the current spec W 2450 mm -> 4.036 mm/px; the resulting height 582 px = 2349 mm agrees with spec H 2320 mm to 1.2%), cross-checked against the 2026 Aconity front photo scaled by the same 957 mm control-cabinet width (2.323 mm/px; base-cabinet top 980 vs 977 mm, worktop 1162 vs 1166 mm, chamber top 1289 vs 1300 mm). MIDI+ from Aconity's front photo (Teaser_MIDI+.png, alpha mask, 2.088 mm/px from the same ~960 mm control cabinet; total width then 2679 mm vs spec 2700 mm). Monitor (~589 mm) and keyboard (~427 mm) widths are consistent with that scale. No side view or depth sub-dimension is published anywhere found, so every y (depth) value is an estimate. PDFs parsed with PyMuPDF; the 2018 MIDI flyer's text is outlined vector art, so its quotes were read from the rendered page image.
_meta.axes: x = along the width from the left edge of the envelope as seen from the front; y = depth from the front face (0 = front, positive toward the back); z = height from the floor.
_meta.status: The lab has not bought one yet, so the configuration (lasers, filter, chiller, setup station) is still open. Model the base system plus the always-present filter unit; optional peripherals are listed separately.

aconity_midi.name: Aconity3D AconityMIDI (laser powder bed fusion, current design with dual-laser 3D-scanner optics portal)
aconity_midi.dims_note: Current manufacturer figure (configurator API and aconity3d.com product page, 2026). The 2018 flyer and the 2022 datasheet give 2170 x 1590 x 2340 mm for the earlier design. Photo proportions indicate that the 2450 mm width includes the side-standing filter unit (left) and the 2320 mm height includes the fibre loops above the scan heads. Conservative planning box that covers both specs: 2450 x 1590 x 2340 mm.
aconity_midi.mass_note: Without powder. The 2018 flyer gives 1385 kg.

build_envelope.note: The 2018 flyer and the RMU facility page give H 250 mm for the Ø170 build cylinder; current data give H 200 mm. Build cylinder and powder reservoir cylinder are both reduced by the reduction kits.

aconity_midi.lasers: Current: up to 2 lasers, 200-4000 W, multiple beam profiles, different wavelengths (2026 flyer). The configurator base article lists 1x green single-mode 200/500 W; up to 2x IR single-mode 400/500/700/1000/1200 W AFX. The 2022 datasheet said 'up to 4 x Infrared'. Optics: 2D F-theta (80 µm spot) or 3D scanner (80-500 µm); 3D green scanner 50-250 µm. Max scan speed 12 m/s. The laser source sits as a 19-inch rack unit in the control cabinet (configurator render).
aconity_midi.preheating: 500 °C / Ø170 x H180 mm; 800 °C / Ø100 x H180 mm; 1200 °C / Ø70 x H150 mm (inductive).
aconity_midi.inert_gas: Argon 4.6 / 6 bar or nitrogen / 6 bar; <5 l/min during process, <30 l/min (2022 datasheet) or <60 l/min (current API) during purging; residual O2 <100 ppm. Optional vacuum ≤2 mbar absolute (MIDI only).

utilities.electrical_US_option: UL wiring option: 208 V, WYE, 32 A (3PH + N + PE)
utilities.cooling: Chiller required for the heating unit and for lasers above 400 W: air-water 15.3 kW or water-water 15.8 kW (Aconity option)

aconity_midi.powder_handling: Two cylinders under the exchangeable process chamber (powder reservoir + build cylinder). Only one column is visible from the front in the configurator render, which suggests they sit front-to-back (inferred). Recoater with exchangeable rubber, knife or brush. The process chamber can be swapped out, with an optional external setup station, and the filter unit stands beside the machine. Neither machine has glove ports. The separate AconityXTRACT depowdering station has them.

layout.front_access: Everything is operated from the front: the chamber comes out forward (it is exchangeable), and the base door and control-cabinet doors open forward. Allow roughly 1 m of clear floor in front (planning assumption, not a spec).

images.description: Current dual-laser MIDI at CMU, with the filter unit. From left: filter unit ~18% of total width, a black cylinder over a drum with conical hopper on legs, ~0.6 of machine height. Main machine ~38%: single-door base cabinet to ~42% of the height, small chamber with LED-lit viewport at ~1.15 m, black aluminium portal with two scan heads at ~1.5-1.8 m, yellow fibre loops to the top. Control cabinet ~39%: wood worktop at ~50% of height, tall rear box with cyan LED strip at ~81%, monitor on pole, e-stop and button panel on left door. W/H = 607/582 px = 1.04 (spec 2450/2320 = 1.06).

Same current MIDI without the filter unit. Main machine (base cabinet 395 px wide) and control cabinet (412 px) side by side, base+control 840 px wide, floor-to-fibre-top 935 px. Base cabinet top at 45% of the fibre-top height, worktop at 53%, tower top at 84%. The small yellow-lit viewport is centred at ~1.18 m.
Small transparent-background cut-out of the same studio photo (500x334 px).

UNT CAAAM installation (older 3D-scanner portal with a cantilevered Z-axis). Left to right: step ladder for reaching the optics, main machine, control cabinet with 2 monitors, the setup station with its own monitor, and a rack cabinet. Useful for how the system sits against a wall with a ~2.4 m clear ceiling zone.

Full MIDI system (2018/2022 design): setup station with a second chamber on an aluminium frame, PC cart, wood-top vacuum/aux cabinet with e-stop, main machine, control cabinet with green-lit tower. Everything anthracite/black with wood worktops.

Base machine alone with the front door open: a central column (single visible cylinder + linear actuator) under the chamber, portal frame above. Other layers on the same 2280x1040 canvas (controlling_..., rust_station_..., vacuuum_option_..., E19_04...) composite into the whole system at one common scale.

aconity_midi.notes: Two published MIDI envelopes exist: 2170 x 1590 x 2340 mm (2018 flyer and 2022 datasheet; older design) and 2450 x 1500 x 2320 mm (current product page and configurator). For a new purchase, use 2450 x 1500 x 2320 mm and 1450 kg. On a 2450 x 1500 footprint that is ~1.45 t, about 3.9 kN/m², and the load is concentrated on levelling feet, so check the floor rating. Aconity machines are anthracite/black, not white. The laser safety class depends on the optional laser-proof enclosure: without it the machine is Class 4 and the room needs interlocked access.

aconity_midi_plus.name: Aconity3D AconityMIDI+ (laser powder bed fusion, production-research hybrid)
aconity_midi_plus.dims_note: Identical in the 2019 flyer, the 2022 datasheet, the current configurator/product page and ET Additive. The front photo scales to about 2680 mm wide (main machine + control cabinet) and about 2660 mm to the top of the fibres, so the 3000 mm height presumably includes vertical travel of the scan unit (a configurator option) and/or service clearance. Model the 3000 mm as a clearance box.
aconity_midi_plus.lasers: Up to 4 lasers (QUATTRO), 200-4000 W, multiple beam profiles, green option (1x 200/500 W). 3D scanners only (no F-theta option in the current data).
aconity_midi_plus.inert_gas: Argon 4.6 / 6 bar or nitrogen / 6 bar; <5 l/min process; <30 (2019/2022 datasheets) or <60 (current API) l/min purging; O2 <100 ppm. No vacuum option.
aconity_midi_plus.powder_handling: Bidirectional and vibrating powder deposition with a twin powder supply: three cylinders (supply, build, supply) are visible on the spare chamber in the configurator render. Optional multi-material deposition (Aerosint) for up to 3 materials. Exchangeable process chamber with optional setup station.
aconity_midi_plus.colours: Same palette as the MIDI: anthracite/black panels, black aluminium portal, wood worktop, cyan/green LED strip on the control tower. The chamber has a long dark-blue/yellow-tinted horizontal viewport.
